# Vendored dependencies

- `math.min.js` — mathjs 13.0.3, from cdnjs (https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/mathjs/13.0.3/math.min.js). Apache-2.0.
- `tex-svg.js` — MathJax 3.2.2 (TeX input, SVG output), from jsDelivr (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3.2.2/es5/tex-svg.js). Apache-2.0.

Vendored so the app does not depend on CDNs that school networks may block.
